messages:
nik: who's up for the World Cup finals watch? big screen in kitchen at 10pm, snacks provided. :tv:

ana: count me in. i'll bring empanadas. who's on halftime playlist duty?

geo: i volunteer my terrible 2008 playlist. apologies in advance.

sam: also we should do a tiny pool: exact score prediction $2. winner gets themed mystery prize.

score-bot: pool link: https://pool.example/wcup-final (entries close 9:50pm)

nik: rules: single entry per person, no edits after 9:50. please post your prediction in thread too for bragging rights.

ana: 2-1 OT for me. snack duty: empanadas plus hot sauce.

geo: 1-0 surprise upset. soundtrack: dramatic violin.

sam: 3-2 penalties. and i demand a kazoo chorus if it goes to pens.

nik: solid. kitchen booked 9:30 for setup. bring a blanket if you want to camp. no chairs on the counter pls. :no_entry_sign:

score-bot: reminder scheduled for 9:40pm re: pool close and snack locations.

ana: may the best prediction win and may the empanadas stay warm. :crossed_fingers:
